item.title: A.O. Smith CEO says company’s China strategy won’t include long-term cuts
item.description: A.O. Smith CEO Steve Shafer says the company does not plan any long-term cuts to its China business despite declining sales.

item.title: Former Milwaukee tax preparer pleads guilty in $3.3 million IRS fraud scheme
item.description: A Milwaukee tax preparer has pled guilty to filing hundreds of fraudulent tax returns, causing more than $1.8 million in losses to the IRS.
